description: POI Factory is a data resource listed in Free GIS Data (rtwilson), a curated list of free geographic datasets under the section "Buildings, Roads and Points of Interest", published or maintained by the publisher of poi-factory.com. Point of Interest files originally designed for use in GPS units, but they can be loaded into a GIS fairly easily. Widely varying quality, and coverage, but includes such things as shop and business locations (eg. all Tesco stores, all McDonald's restaurants) as well as places of worship, speed cameras etc. Registration is required. Coverage: worldwide or as described in the list entry. The list files it under "Buildings, Roads and Points of Interest". The entry links to poi-factory.com. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated in the list entry (source page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure mapping and planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-free-gis-data-list.
